summary: Frontend e2e validation of the NEW 2-step taxi map flow (/course). STANDARD mode is GREEN end-to-end: address Step1 → destination autocomplete selection triggers AUTO-SWITCH to Step2 (ride-route-map + map-bottom-sheet + map-back-btn + payment-dropdown + 10 vehicles + 10 prices), CTA creates the order and navigates to /ride/ride_3373e380c10a (no error overlay). Rental & Buddy correctly STAY single-screen (no dropoff field, no map, single-price-card + inline payment). POOL panel + INTERCITY panel + BIDDING panel render but the auto-transition to Step2 was NOT observed in this run for those three modes (step2_map=false after pac-item click) — most likely an IP-geolocation pickup race (pickup not yet resolved when the destination autocomplete is selected, so `if (pickup?.lat) setShowMap(true)` short-circuits).

integration_issues.issue: After selecting a destination via .pac-item, the page stayed on Step1 (no ride-route-map / map-bottom-sheet / map-back-btn). Reproduced 3/3 modes. STANDARD worked because autoLocate finished before destination selection. Root cause: in onDropoffSelect (RideChoosePage.js line ~326) the transition `if (pickup?.lat) setShowMap(true)` only fires when pickup is already set; if the IP-based autoLocate hasn't resolved yet at the moment the user picks the suggestion, the user is stuck on Step1 with no clear next step (the continue-to-map-btn only appears once `bothSet` becomes true). When pickup finally arrives the page does NOT auto-advance.

After clicking map-back-btn in Step2, the assertion `pickup present AND map absent` returned false. Either map is still mounted briefly (animation) OR pickup field is briefly removed. continue-to-map-btn was NOT visible. Needs visual check by main agent.

Add a useEffect: `if (needsDropoff && pickup?.lat && dropoff?.lat && !showMap) setShowMap(true)` to handle the race where the user picks the suggestion before IP-geolocate finishes. Alternatively, surface a clearer loading state on the pickup row while autoLocate runs and disable destination selection until pickup is set.
Verify map-back-btn → Step1 transition visually. If pickup state remains, ensure continue-to-map-btn renders so the user can re-enter Step2 (it should because bothSet is true).
critical_code_review_comments: Race condition between IP autoLocate (async server round-trip) and user picking Google autocomplete suggestion: onDropoffSelect only sets showMap when pickup is already resolved. Use a useEffect that watches both `pickup` and `dropoff` so the transition happens whichever order they arrive in.

Step2 unmounts step1; if the user clicks map-back-btn then re-opens by setShowMap(true) via continue-to-map-btn, ensure the addresses are preserved (currently they appear to be — pickup/dropoff state lives in the parent so OK).

rca of the issue: Race condition: onDropoffSelect at RideChoosePage.js:326 reads `pickup?.lat` synchronously. The pickup is initialized by autoLocate() which fires on mount but completes asynchronously after a network round-trip to /api/geo/ip-locate. On modes where the user picks the destination quickly (often inside ~2 s — pool/intercity/bidding tests), pickup is still null when onDropoffSelect runs, so setShowMap(true) is skipped. The user is then stuck on Step1 with no auto-advance, and continue-to-map-btn only appears once `bothSet` becomes true — there is currently NO effect that auto-advances when pickup arrives AFTER the user has already picked the destination. Mitigation: add `useEffect(() => { if (needsDropoff && pickup?.lat && dropoff?.lat && !showMap) setShowMap(true); }, [pickup, dropoff, needsDropoff, showMap]);`. STANDARD mode passed because it ran first and IP-geo had time to complete; subsequent modes ran on freshly-loaded pages where the race triggered.
